The permanent one applies to every bot of this server: when it joins a voice channel the bot shows the song that is playing and follows each track change.
**Attention:** `{requester_name}` and `{requester_id}` are public in the channel status.
The buttons without "(permanent)" change only this session: it goes back to the permanent one when the bot changes channel or restarts. To turn it off for good, use the permanent one (empty text).
